execution_order.text: Farmers in Africa typically sell vegetables to the first buyer for whatever price they offer.
Farmers face difficulties selling produce at the farm gate, resulting in significant losses.
Dried kales or skumawiki can be stored for more than two years without spoilage.
Drying vegetables increases their shelf life and market value.
Vegetables should be blanched in steam or boiling water to maintain color and flavor.
Proper blanching includes steaming for half the required drying time.
Solar dryers have wooden frames with wire mesh trays covered in clear plastic.
Farmers should load trays with sliced vegetables to increase surface area for drying.
Trays should be placed in the solar dryer when fully exposed to the sun.
